scope: Post-publication pair/span registration and exact English bag-note persistence; canonical image mapping is a separate deferred patch. No word seeds, category changes or routine bag writer.
bagPersistence: After publication only, append the reviewed English bag-note usage to data/etymology-en.json, preserving all other fields and entries, so future manual apply-localized-texts does not restore the old note. Traditional-Chinese base note, Japanese note and alias exact deltas remain in the reviewed proposal; normal migration does not rewrite these fields.
